title: Deduplicate ParentDashboardAggregator.compute() coverage across _compute_test.dart and _extended_test.dart

evidence.quote: test('includes recent completions from last 7 days', () async {
test('includes recent completions within 7-day window', () async {

why: Both files independently seed a track+completion and assert the same compute() outputs (zero-state, points sum, 7-day recency cutoff) with different fixture-setup idioms and literal point values, and both carry a computeCompletionPercentage test with the exact same name and assertion ('returns 0.0 when no completions'). A change to the 7-day window boundary has to be re-verified in two places with different fixture styles, and neither file signals that the other asserts the same contract.
recommendation: Merge parent_dashboard_aggregator_compute_test.dart into parent_dashboard_aggregator_extended_test.dart (keep the union of scenarios); drop the exact-duplicate 'no completions -> 0.0' case. Leave migration_test.dart separate — it covers a genuinely distinct tier-filter scenario set.
acceptance_criteria: One file covers ParentDashboardAggregator.compute()'s DB-backed path with no scenario loss.

corrections: Same TQ-1 mistag as finding 3 (pyramid-shape rule misapplied to duplication) — cosmetic labeling issue only, the duplication itself is real and precisely evidenced.
